label: Town of Washington
header:
# Town of Washington municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Washington, 'Current Officials' page (washingtonvt.org): lists the five-member board -- Josh Bell, Maria West, Tammy Johnson, Jennifer Farnham, and Ricky Roberts. Concordant with the Secretary of State directory (which shows Johnson as Chair and styles her in full; the page's 'Jen Farnham' is Jennifer Farnham)

Town of Washington, 'Current Officials' page (washingtonvt.org): lists Lois Deberville as Town Clerk, three-year term to 2028. She is also a Justice of the Peace; one person record carries both memberships
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lois Deberville as Washington's Town Clerk

Town of Washington, 'Current Officials' page (washingtonvt.org): lists Scott Blanchard as Town Treasurer, three-year term to 2028. He is also the Collector of Delinquent Taxes and a Justice of the Peace; one person record carries all three memberships
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Scott Blanchard as Washington's Town Treasurer
Town of Washington, 'Current Officials' page (washingtonvt.org): lists Ben Tiefenthaler as Moderator, one-year term expiring 2027 (elected at the March 2026 floor meeting)

Town of Washington, 'Current Officials' page (washingtonvt.org): lists Robert Farnham (term to 2027), Tony Ziter (to 2028), and Robert Blanchard (to 2029) on three-year terms

Town of Washington, 'Current Officials' page (washingtonvt.org): lists Andrea Poulin (to 2027), Linda Beede (to 2028), Joyce Waters (to 2028, on a two-year term), Maxine Durbrow (to 2029), and Jacob Pelletier (to 2030). The page notes the trustees voted to move to two-year terms going forward

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Washington justices of the peace: Scott Blanchard, Peter Carbee, Lois Deberville, Ray McCormack, H. Brooke Paige, Harry Roush, and Anna Strong

jp_election.name: Town of Washington Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the seven winners of Washington's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for seven): Scott Blanchard, Peter Carbee, Lois Deberville, Ray McCormack, H. Brooke Paige, Harry Roush, and Anna Strong. All seven remain in office
